How to play

  1. Tap a tile. It flips, and so do the 4 next to it.
  2. Goal: turn every tile off.
  3. Par = the fewest taps that can do it.
  4. A new puzzle every day at midnight. Everyone gets the same one.
  5. Solve days in a row to grow your streak.
  6. Practice gives a random puzzle. It doesn't touch your streak.

Flip a tileTap itArrows, then Space or Enter
